business_problem: Boehringer Ingelheim had millions of unstructured text documents in inconsistent formats and quality states, making it hard for teams across the business to analyze the data, surface insights, and respond quickly to complex medical inquiries.
solution_summary: Boehringer Ingelheim worked with Capgemini Invent to turn large volumes of underused unstructured text into a reusable analytics service. The engagement started with design-thinking workshops in 2020 to define use cases, business value, and funding, then moved into an agile build with consultants, data scientists, and software developers. The resulting solution was a fully customized, microservice-oriented NLP analytics platform rather than an off-the-shelf tool, so the team could match the company’s data, workflows, and IP requirements. Text documents from multiple internal sources are brought into the platform for NLP analysis under a scalable Machine Learning Operations approach, while continuous integration and deployment let the team release services iteratively. After an MVP in 2021 and a 2022 pilot, the platform was rolled out worldwide so trained users across Boehringer Ingelheim could access shared insights and support medical inquiry work faster.

solution_components.name: Custom NLP-driven analytics platform
solution_components.role: Provides the user-facing analytics environment through which teams analyze unstructured documents, access generated insights, and deliver data-related services across the business.

solution_components.name: Natural Language Processing (NLP) algorithms
solution_components.role: Analyze unstructured text from multiple sources to derive insights and support faster responses to complex medical inquiries.

solution_components.name: Machine Learning Operations approach
solution_components.role: Supports scalable development, integration, and deployment of stakeholder-relevant NLP services across the platform.

data_flow: Unstructured text documents from multiple internal sources are brought into the custom NLP-driven analytics platform, where NLP algorithms analyze the content under a scalable Machine Learning Operations approach; the resulting insights are then exposed to trained users across Boehringer Ingelheim, who use them to answer complex medical inquiries and provide data-related services faster.
integration_points: More than 100 trained users across Boehringer Ingelheim
business_outcome: The platform gave employees across Boehringer Ingelheim access to previously underused insights, cut response time for complex medical inquiries by over 40%, enabled shared data-related services across the business, and is expected to deliver substantial annual financial benefits as the rollout scales worldwide.
